# MAR Pact Safe Version Rewrite Brief — 2026-05-09

```text
STATUS: REWRITE BRIEF — CANDIDATE / NOT CANON
SOURCE: Atlas Prime adjustment after Copilot adversarial review, supplied by Dave
CANON STATUS: NOT RATIFIED
OUTREACH STATUS: NOT APPROVED FOR DISPATCH
IP POSTURE: NO IP CLAIM
PURPOSE: Preserve the corrected direction for transforming a high-energy MAR Pact simulation artifact into a safe external-facing concept note.
```

## Context

A prior MAR Pact activation draft was quarantined because it used dispatch-ready and authority-heavy language before quote-level receipts, human-root lane selection, or outreach approval.

Copilot reportedly scored the simulation artifact highly as a design compass while correctly identifying that the real-world outbound version required heavy softening.

Atlas Prime then accepted the adversarial review and requested a safe-version rewrite that keeps the four strategic lanes but strips overclaim, implied authority, and causal guarantees.

## Corrected Framing

Replace:

```text
MAR Pact Activation
Strategic Mandate
Finalized for Dispatch
Signal Locked
ARES-GREEN
```

With:

```text
Proposal for a Shared Regenerative Infrastructure Framework
MAR Concept Draft
Strategic Engagement Thought Experiment
Candidate Concept Note
Not Approved for Dispatch
```

## Preserved Strategic Lanes

The safe version may preserve the four lane structure:

```text
1. Agentic interoperability / neutral routing kernel
2. India infrastructure / hydrological-risk coordination
3. Clean Transition Tariff / GoldenTrace / clean-energy procurement
4. Planetary Computer ↔ Earth Engine / STAC / geospatial intelligence
```

## Required Language Changes

Use conditional and exploratory language:

```text
could
may
might
appears to
would be worth exploring
candidate framework
proposed neutral layer
modeled hypothesis
```

Avoid absolute or authority-claiming language:

```text
activation
mandate
authorized
finalized for dispatch
will ensure
proves
required neutral substrate
guarantees ROI
bypasses regulators
```

## Epistemic Labels Required

Every major section should distinguish:

```text
confirmed public claim
source-linked but not quote-verified
modeled hypothesis
strategic inference
internal design concept
unverified claim
```

## Safe Role for Lattice

```text
The Lattice should be framed as an open, forkable, experimental governance and regenerative-infrastructure proposal, not as a recognized standards body, regulator, or existing inter-company authority.
```

## Safe External Artifact Type

Recommended first external-facing artifact:

```text
One-page strategic concept note
```

Not:

```text
direct executive invitation
signed MAR Pact
formal activation
standards mandate
```

## Required Before Any External Send

```text
1. Complete receipt table for Microsoft/Google claims.
2. Classify all claims as confirmed / plausible / inference / unsupported.
3. Produce conservative safe wording.
4. Human-root selects lane and audience.
5. Draft external note with simulation-only footer removed only after review.
6. Final human-root approval before any outbound communication.
```

## Strongest Safe Claim

```text
The MAR Pact concept is strategically strong as a simulation artifact and design compass. For real-world use, it must be rewritten as a conservative, source-labeled proposal exploring whether a neutral, open, regenerative infrastructure framework could help hyperscalers manage agentic interoperability, ecological constraints, and public legitimacy.
```

## Boundary

```text
A 10/10 simulation score does not imply dispatch readiness.
A design compass is not an outbound letter.
Modeled benefits are not proven outcomes.
Strategic alignment is not authority.
Human-root remains final authority.
```
